title: Ideal 8-bit DAC Model
constraints: `VREF` is a `real` parameter / generic, default `1.0`. The judge instantiates the model with `VREF = 2.5`.
`vout = code / 256 * VREF`, updated on each rising edge of `clk` (a clocked DAC register).
`vout` starts at `0.0` and holds between edges.
Checked with an absolute tolerance of 1e-9 V.
hints: Convert the unsigned code to a real first: SystemVerilog allows `real'(code)`, VHDL uses `real(to_integer(unsigned(code)))`.
Divide by 256.0, not 255.0: full scale is one LSB below VREF.
Make the update edge-triggered so `vout` holds between edges.

examples.title: random codes
examples.expected: vout = 60/256 * 2.5 = 0.5859375 after the next rising edge

examples.title: full ramp
examples.expected: vout rises in steps of VREF / 256
